newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASKETBALL-FIBA TO CONSIDER SCORING ARC CHANGE.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-FIBA TO CONSIDER SCORING ARC CHANGE.

text.p: Plans to extend the three-point scoring arc have been drawn up by the world technical commission of FIBA, the governing body of international basketball.
The commission wants the line pushed out 45 centimetres to 6.70 metres from 6.25 to come in line with the NBA in the U.S., FIBA spokesman Marcos Beltra said on Wednesday.
The proposal, making it slightly harder to score three-pointers, has been produced in time to be included in the next official rules which will cover the period up to 2002.
It will now be submitted to FIBA's secretary general ahead of the organisation's next World Congress in Athens in July 1998.
The commission is also recommending that in all women's national and international matches a smaller basketball may be used if wished.
